Activity, catalog, network and exposure data: IMF PortWatch
https://portwatch.imf.org/
Underlying sources: UN Global Platform (observed activity); University of
Oxford (network and economic models), as attributed in the source metadata.
IMF terms: https://www.imf.org/en/about/copyright-and-terms
Third-party product terms may also apply. Commercial reuse is not authorized
by this repository; consult the source terms and obtain required permissions.

Passage reformats observations and calculates descriptive comparisons. These
are Passage's calculations, not IMF findings. Preserve source attribution and
distinguish derived results from original observations. No endorsement by the
IMF, its management, Executive Board or member countries is implied.

land.json: Natural Earth 1:110m land geometry, public domain.
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

Source notices and links in events, signal context and test fixtures remain
